summary: Backend-only regression for the admin-promotion fix (one-phone == one-account rule; Roberto +393455119796 promoted to admin with premium subscription; test admin +393331234567 untouched). 11/11 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_admin_promotion.py. Verified: (1) POST /api/auth/login with +393331234567/Admin2026! returns 200 with user.is_admin=true (regression preserved). (2) GET /api/admin/users returns Roberto (+393455119796) with is_admin=true AND subscription.status='premium'. (3) Exactly 2 documents with is_admin=true in the users collection — phones are {+393331234567, +393455119796}. (4) POST /api/auth/register with an already-existing phone returns 409 (tested for BOTH +393455119796 and +393331234567) — duplicate-phone protection enforced. (5) DELETE /api/admin/users/{self_id} returns 400 ('Non puoi eliminare te stesso') — self-delete guard confirmed. (6) DELETE /api/admin/users/{nonexistent-uuid} returns 404. (7) End-of-run state preserved: both admins still exist and test admin login still returns 200. NO destructive test was performed on the 'last remaining admin' code path (see critical_code_review_comments) — the state constraint was honoured.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_user() 'last remaining admin' guard (lines 1218-1222) is effectively UNREACHABLE via the public API: to hit it, the only-admin caller would have to delete another admin, but by definition if remaining_admins==0 then target==caller, and the earlier self-check at line 1216 already returns 400. It is fine as defensive code but consider a comment or admin-transfer endpoint if the intent was to allow removing other admins in a last-admin scenario.
server.py is now ~1900 lines (recurring finding from prior iterations) — split /admin routes into a router module.
POST /api/auth/register uses HTTP 409 for duplicate phone which is correct; consider documenting that response in the OpenAPI schema (currently only default validation errors are described).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are strictly read-only w.r.t. persistent data — no user was created, deleted, or mutated. Only calls made: /api/auth/login (test admin), /api/auth/me, GET /api/admin/users, and 4xx-returning DELETE/register attempts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Auth envelope is {access_token, token_type, user}. pytest.ini injects `-n auto --dist loadscope`; override with `-o addopts=''` if running a single-worker debug session. Do NOT delete or change password of +393331234567 or +393455119796. The 'last-admin' guard on DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} is unreachable via the API surface as noted in critical_code_review_comments — do not attempt destructive testing of it.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a verification pass for a code+data fix already applied by the main agent (promote-existing-user script). Verified state matches the intent: 2 admins exist, Roberto has premium, both logins work, and one-phone-one-account is enforced at /api/auth/register.
